text: 据澎湃，2026年前三季度A股新股上市首日零破发，首日收盘单签浮盈过万的超过四成。根据Wind数据统计，今年前三季度，123家企业在A股挂牌上市，截至首日收盘无一破发。与此同时，A股市场有57只新股的单签（沪深新股每签500股，北交所新股每签100股）浮盈过万元（以首日收盘价计算，下同），占比46%。首日收盘浮盈方面，前三季度上市的新股中，有10只新股的首日收盘单签浮盈超过10万元，其中7只为科创板上市企业，包括4只单签浮盈超过30万元的超级“大肉签”。首日涨幅方面，123只新股中，19股首日涨幅超过500%，96只新股的首日收盘涨幅翻番，占比78%。
text_en: According to The Paper, in the first three quarters of 2026, A-share IPOs had zero first-day breakages, and more than 40% of first-day closing per-lot floating profits exceeded 10,000 yuan. According to Wind data, in the first three quarters of this year, 123 companies listed on the A-share market, and none had broken issue price by the first-day close. At the same time, 57 new shares in the A-share market had per-lot floating profits of more than 10,000 yuan (Shanghai and Shenzhen new shares are 500 shares per lot, Beijing Stock Exchange new shares are 100 shares per lot) (calculated based on the first-day closing price, the same below), accounting for 46%. In terms of first-day closing floating profits, among the new shares listed in the first three quarters, 10 new shares had first-day closing per-lot floating profits exceeding 100,000 yuan, of which 7 were STAR Market-listed companies, including 4 super "big meat" lots with per-lot floating profits exceeding 300,000 yuan. In terms of first-day gains, among the 123 new shares, 19 rose more than 500% on the first day, and 96 new shares doubled by the first-day close, accounting for 78%.
